name: Breeze Canna x Skunk House Pro Rosin Disposable Vape | Funkfetti
description: Born from an obsession with exceptional cannabis, SkunkHouse Genetics has been crafting elite genetics since 2008—combining standout terpene profiles, serious potency, and grower-focused structure that helped shape modern hash-making through their work with GMO. This hybrid delivers sweet-meets-skunky flavor, and happy, creative energy with a touch of caryophyllene spice—social enough for daytime, yet potent enough for night.
